msg.burmaldaholic.worldgen.entered_subti: Please gamble responsibly. Or at least entertainingly.
gui.burmaldaholic.croupier.title: Croupier
dialog.burmaldaholic.croupier.greeting.1: Welcome! The tables are warm and the odds are… fair. Mostly.
dialog.burmaldaholic.croupier.greeting.2: Feeling lucky? A scratch card is a gentle start.
dialog.burmaldaholic.croupier.greeting.3: Hrm. (The croupier adjusts his bow tie meaningfully.)
dialog.burmaldaholic.piglin_dealer.greet: Snort! Gold on the table, gold in the pocket. Mine, mostly.
You wear no gold. Bold. The dice don't care.
House rules: no mining the tables. Everything else — allowed.
dialog.burmaldaholic.shulker_croupier.gr: (The shulker opens its shell just enough to take your bet.)
High rollers only. You'll float out if you lose. Joke. Mostly.
msg.burmaldaholic.worldgen.build_failed: Could not build a casino here. Is the "Burmaldaholic Casinos" data pack enabled?
